note: Every count is tied to a named row universe. Do not subtract counts from different universes.

mirror_total.definition: lerobot/droid_1.0.1 mirror episode rows; no building restriction

mirror_building_nonmissing.definition: mirror rows with nonmissing building; 1,664 missing excluded
mirror_building_nonmissing.used_for: mirror building axis; gap 20,581 is this minus raw_scene_nonmissing

raw_metadata_objects.used_for: raw total only; gap 20,762 is mirror_total minus this

raw_metadata_unique_uuid.definition: raw metadata objects after uuid duplicates; 101 duplicate rows

raw_scene_nonmissing.definition: raw scene_id nonmissing and not -1, after duplicate removal; matches droid_scene.csv.gz
raw_scene_nonmissing.used_for: native scene axis and single-source rows

raw_scene_valid_before_dedup.definition: raw scene_id nonmissing and not -1 before uuid dedup; 98 duplicate rows removed

raw_scene_minus_one.used_for: scene exclusion only, not a collision id

single_source_rows.definition: six-column raw single-source table used by all three axes
